Boy, would it be neat in certain kinds of programming for
GET to be an LSUBR!  (GET x p1 p2 p3 ... pn) =>
(GET ... (GET (GET (GET x p1) p2) p3) ... pn)
Great for super property-list hackers (like GJS).
